nodes.description: Grade 4

nodes.title: Natural Sciences and Technology
nodes.description: Grade 4 Natural Sciences and Technology

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Grade 4 Natural Sciences and Technology Term 1

nodes.title: Life and Living: Living and Non-Living Things
nodes.description: Distinguish between living and non-living things. Identify characteristics of living things: movement, growth, nutrition, reproduction, respiration, excretion, sensitivity.

nodes.title: Life and Living: Structure of Plants and Animals
nodes.description: Identify and describe the external structures of plants and animals. Describe the functions of plant parts: roots, stems, leaves and flowers.

nodes.title: Matter and Materials: States of Matter and the Water Cycle
nodes.description: Describe the three states of matter: solids, liquids and gases. Describe the water cycle: evaporation, condensation and precipitation.

nodes.title: Energy and Change: Energy Transfer
nodes.description: Investigate how energy can be transferred from one form to another. Identify sources of energy and energy transfer in everyday life.

nodes.title: Planet Earth and Beyond: Planet Earth
nodes.description: Describe the shape and structure of planet Earth. Identify layers of the Earth: core, mantle and crust.

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — Test or Assignment.

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Grade 4 Natural Sciences and Technology Term 2

nodes.title: Life and Living: Plant Growth
nodes.description: Investigate the conditions necessary for plant growth: light, water, nutrients and suitable temperatures. Describe the process of germination.

nodes.title: Matter and Materials: Solid Materials
nodes.description: Investigate the properties of solid materials: hardness, flexibility, transparency, ability to absorb water. Compare and classify solid materials.

nodes.title: Technology: Strengthening and Frames
nodes.description: Investigate ways of strengthening materials. Design and make frame structures using appropriate materials and joining methods.

nodes.title: Energy and Change: Energy Around Us
nodes.description: Identify different forms of energy in the environment: light, heat, sound, kinetic, electrical. Describe how energy is used in daily life.

nodes.title: Planet Earth and Beyond: The Sun
nodes.description: Describe the Sun as a star and source of energy. Explain how the Sun provides light and heat to Earth.

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — Test or Assignment.

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Grade 4 Natural Sciences and Technology Term 3

nodes.title: Life and Living: Habitats
nodes.description: Describe different habitats: forest, grassland, wetland, desert, ocean. Explain how plants and animals are adapted to their habitats.

nodes.title: Energy and Change: Musical Instruments
nodes.description: Investigate how musical instruments produce sound. Classify instruments as string, wind or percussion. Describe how vibrations produce sound.

nodes.title: Energy and Change: Sound and Vibrations
nodes.description: Investigate how sound travels through different materials. Describe properties of sound: pitch and volume. Investigate how sound is produced by vibrations.

nodes.title: Planet Earth and Beyond: Earth and Sun
nodes.description: Describe the relationship between Earth and the Sun. Explain how Earth's rotation causes day and night. Describe seasonal changes related to Earth's orbit.

nodes.title: Planet Earth and Beyond: The Moon
nodes.description: Describe the Moon as Earth's natural satellite. Identify the phases of the Moon. Explain how the Moon reflects light from the Sun.

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — Test or Assignment.

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Grade 4 Natural Sciences and Technology Term 4

nodes.title: Life and Living: Animal Shelters
nodes.description: Investigate the shelters that animals build or use. Compare natural animal shelters with human-made shelters. Describe the materials animals use.

nodes.title: Technology: Rocket Systems
nodes.description: Investigate how rockets work using Newton's third law. Design and make a simple rocket or projectile system.

nodes.title: Matter and Materials: Review and Consolidation
nodes.description: Review and consolidate understanding of matter and materials covered across Grade 4. Describe properties and uses of different materials.

nodes.title: Revision and Consolidation
nodes.description: Revision and consolidation of all Grade 4 Natural Sciences and Technology content.

nodes.title: Formal Assessment Task
nodes.description: Formal Assessment Task — End-of-year Test.
